card.name: Linking words in sedative drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a sedative or anesthesia drug (diazepam, hydroxyzine, morphine), or in 'such as' before one. The setting is a list of sedatives, barbiturates or premedications.

modes.label: After a sedative name
modes.description: An 'or', 'and' or comma follows diazepam or another premedication drug, leading into the next drug in the list.
modes.example: Convulsions may be treated with intravenous administration of diazepam<< or>> a barbiturate such as pentobar

modes.label: Before a sedative name
modes.description: 'such as' or part of 'intramuscular' introduces a sedative or opioid class.
modes.example: increments of an ultra-short acting barbiturate (such as thiopental or thiamylal) or a benzodiazepine (such<< as>> diazepam) may be administered intr

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward other drug names that start with 'Mid' or 'sol', such as midazolam.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or 'or' after a sedative like diazepam, where another sedative is likely to come next.
